subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine writelog_a(destination, form, a_message_char1)
  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else

      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.

      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace

         call xmpi_abort

         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace

      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif

      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &

      call halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank

         call backtrace

         call xmpi_abort

      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal

      if(present(normal)) then

#else

#endif

subroutine halt_program(normal)

      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

         lnormal = normal

#else
      stop 1

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace

         call xmpi_abort

      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace

      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else

      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace

      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.

      if (lnormal) then

      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace

         call xmpi_abort

         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine writelog_a(destination, form, a_message_char1)
  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display
  character(*), intent(in) :: a_message_char1

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error
